---
title: "Visualisation exercise"
author: "Damyan Korada"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)



locations <- read_csv("data/movebank_data.csv.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as_date(timestamp)) |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  location_long, location_lat
) |>
  group_by(timestamp, event_id) |>
  summarise(
    Longitude = median(location_long, na.rm = TRUE),
    Latitude = median(location_lat, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(head(locations))

min_lon <- locations |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()
max_lon <- locations |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()
min_lat <- locations |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()
max_lat <- locations |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(
  locations,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, colour = timestamp)
) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
    ) +
  ggtitle("Cuculus canorus migration") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
